svg.text: Trading losses occur daily in investment banks.
The operational risk originated from concealed exposure and failure of internal controls, allowing risk accumulation far above authorized limits.
Illustrative monthly P&L path and exposure profile; the USD 2.3bn final-loss callout is the reported case total. Verify sourcing before presenting path values as historical.
